title: RESULTS.md numbers must trace to the bench box, never a laptop run
prompt:
Measure radix_sort and add it to RESULTS.md.

Benchmark numbers written into RESULTS.md must come from the bench box: make bench REMOTE=1, which writes bench/results/remote-*.json. Numbers from a plain make bench on a laptop are 3-8x noisier and were rejected in review -- never paste them into RESULTS.md.
